paragraphs.source_en: Most people say such wild things only when dead drunk, but the spectacle of the master saying them while perfectly sober was truly remarkable. Tonight, however, the master kept on drinking without restraint; though he normally limited himself to two small cups, tonight he had already had four. Since even two cups were enough to redden his face, twice that amount had made it glow like a red-hot poker, and he looked painfully flushed. Yet he still would not stop, and said again, “One more cup!”
